blockingFindings.title: Invoked overrides do not fail closed on human authority or substantive provenance
evidence: scripts/lib/launch-evals.mjs:367-380 only requires nonempty humanAuthority/rationale, a nonempty evidence array, and an array for boundaryChanges; it does not reject a model authority, blank evidence entries, or empty resulting changes.
Read-only QA constructed humanAuthority='automated judge', evidence=[''], boundaryChanges=[]; validateDecisionRecord returned [].
blockingFindings.impact: A model judgment can be represented as a valid override even though policy reserves overrides to a human reviewer with rationale, evidence, and resulting boundary changes.
blockingFindings.requiredRemediation: Require an explicitly human, policy-authorized override identity; validate every evidence entry as substantive text; require substantive resulting boundary changes when an override is invoked; add rejecting mutation tests.

blockingFindings.title: An approved evidence-root symlink can relocate retained evidence outside the repository
evidence: scripts/lib/repo-evidence-path.mjs:37-43 checks the real candidate only relative to the real approved root, but never checks that the real approved root remains under the real repository root.
Read-only temporary-directory QA symlinked repo/approved to an external directory; resolveRepoEvidencePath accepted approved/capture.log.
blockingFindings.impact: Command logs or browser evidence can resolve outside approved repository roots while still satisfying path and digest validation.
blockingFindings.requiredRemediation: Resolve the repository root and each approved root, reject approved roots that escape the real repository root, and add an approved-root-symlink mutation test.

blockingFindings.title: Recursive private-path rejection is not applied to the complete shipped public corpus
evidence: scripts/lib/security-normalization.mjs:13-40 implements recursive percent decoding, Unicode normalization, and fail-closed private-path detection.
scripts/lib/citation-validation.mjs:211 applies containsPrivatePath only to the canonical knowledgeBank object.

scripts/check-public-safety.mjs:184-216 scans shipped files with literal regular expressions and never calls containsPrivatePath; scripts/check-knowledge-bank.mjs:255-260 and 405-410 likewise use literal path patterns.
blockingFindings.impact: A recursively encoded private filesystem path placed directly in TSX, MDX, public data, proofs, or public-safe documentation can bypass the integrated gates and ship in HTML or client bundles.
blockingFindings.requiredRemediation: Apply containsPrivatePath to every shipped/public text corpus and generated public registry input, with integration tests for deeply encoded paths in TSX, MDX, proofs, and public JSON.

blockingFindings.title: Production smoke accepts a blocking robots policy and an unverified resume digest
evidence: scripts/lib/launch-evals.mjs:115 checks only that resume SHA-256 has 64 hexadecimal characters and does not bind it to the committed or fetched resume.
scripts/lib/launch-evals.mjs:130-141 requires an Allow: / line and rejects only an exact Disallow: / line; it does not reject Disallow: /* or evaluate the applicable production user-agent policy.
Read-only QA supplied resume SHA-256='b' repeated 64 times and robots='User-agent: *\nDisallow: /*\nAllow: /'; validateGateEvidence returned [].
blockingFindings.impact: A launch run can record production-smoke success while most routes remain non-indexable and without proof that the production resume was successfully delivered or matched the candidate artifact.
blockingFindings.requiredRemediation: Bind the observed resume body digest and successful HTTP status to the committed artifact, parse or exact-match the production robots policy for the relevant user agent, and cross-bind smoke observations to the approved deployment identifier and candidate SHA.

blockingFindings.title: Encoded protected locators evade public registry and public-surface checks
evidence: docs/knowledge-bank/citational-care.md:91-95 forbids opaque protected locators from public-registry.json, HTML, RSC payloads, and client bundles.
scripts/lib/citation-validation.mjs:216-218 checks protected locators with literal publicJson.includes.
scripts/lib/projection-consistency.mjs:10-12 and 171-180 normalize Unicode and whitespace but do not recursively URL-decode before searching for protected locator IDs.
blockingFindings.impact: A percent-encoded protected locator can enter a public citation field or public source file, remain decodable by a reader or client, and evade both boundary checks.
blockingFindings.requiredRemediation: Recursively decode and security-normalize the generated public registry and complete public corpus before comparing every protected source and locator identifier; add encoded and Unicode mutation tests.

blockingFindings.title: The deterministic runner does not reverify the frozen candidate after command execution
evidence: scripts/run-composite-eval.mjs:24-29 compares the worktree's governed digest with HEAD only before running commands.
scripts/run-composite-eval.mjs:45-69 then executes every required command, and lines 112-136 record and validate the original committed digest without recomputing current governed inputs.
blockingFindings.impact: A command that changes a governed file can make later commands test a mixed or modified worktree while the accepted record remains attributed to the original exact commit.
blockingFindings.requiredRemediation: Recompute the governed worktree digest after every command or at minimum before record construction, reject any drift from the candidate commit, and add a mutation test with a command that writes a governed file and exits zero.
